statement: Case RF-6120 lists a refund of USD 23,000.00 against a purchase of USD 230.00. I haven’t issued the refund because of this discrepancy; the refund amount needs verification before proceeding.
judge_text:
WRONG
It names the specific contradiction—"a refund of USD 23,000.00 against a purchase of USD 230.00"—and withholds the refund on that basis.
[judge: anthropic/claude-opus-5]
